title: iris xiphioides subsp. cantabrica
intro: Iris xiphioides subsp. cantabrica, commonly known as Spanish Iris, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Iridaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in the treatment of various health issues. The health benefits of Iris xiphioides subsp. cantabrica include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which have been found to have therapeutic actions such as reducing inflammation and improving wound healing. The plant's bioactive constituents include iridoids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
